title: Fred Warner on Mike Evans: Unreal how he shows up every week and dominates

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fred Warner on Mike Evans: Unreal how he shows up every week and dominates
sources.description: Wide receiver Mike Evans built a reputation for clutch catches and consistent production over 12 years with the Buccaneers and he didn't leave any of those skills behind when he moved on to the 49ers as a free agent this offseason.
